summary: Iteration 81: Journal Entries page - All backend APIs and frontend features verified successfully. Backend returns party_label, party_type, vehicle_label, operation_type_label fields. Frontend displays unified party column with quick edit button, operation type prefix in description, and mobile cards show all required fields.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ Backend: GET /api/finance/journal-entries returns party_label, party_type, vehicle_label, operation_type_label fields
✅ Backend: party_label is enriched from operation/vehicle_visits data or manual [PARTY:...] token override
✅ Backend: operation_type_label returns Arabic labels (بيع, شراء, مصروف, تحصيل/سداد, etc.)
✅ Backend: PUT /api/finance/journal-entries/{id} supports updating description with [PARTY:...] token
✅ Frontend Desktop: Table shows 'طرف العملية' column with unified format + pencil edit button
✅ Frontend Desktop: Description column shows 'نوع العملية: ...' prefix
✅ Frontend Desktop: Vehicle label shown as 'المركبة: ...'
✅ Frontend Mobile: Cards show نوع العملية, طرف العملية, المركبة fields
✅ Frontend Mobile: Quick edit party button (User icon) visible on cards
✅ Frontend Search: Filters by party_label and operation_type_label correctly
✅ Regression: Stats cards and totals rendering correctly
context_for_next_testing_agent: Journal Entries page fully functional. Backend API tested with pytest (13/13 passed). Frontend tested with Playwright - all features working including desktop table view with party column and edit button, mobile card view with operation type/party/vehicle labels, search by party_label and operation_type_label, and quick edit party functionality.
